channel.description: Questions researched in depth, and articles written from what the research found.

item.title: Paying yourself to do your own tasks: what the incentive trials show, and whether an earn-back subscription could work
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: Financial incentives move behaviour while they run, and losses move people more than equal gains. Paying yourself a wage from your own pocket removes most of what the trials rely on; a subscription you earn back by doing the work is a loss-framed stake, and the research rates it the version most likely to work. Nobody has tested it.

item.title: Missed workouts and broken streaks: how fast strength, mood and habit actually decay
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: Two weeks away from the gym costs almost nothing in muscle — strength holds and the body keeps a record that makes the regain fast. What drains in that time is mood, dopamine tone and the automatic habit, which is exactly what restarting runs on.
